abilities.name: Breach Atlas
abilities.text: Once per round, after you enter or clear a movement/anomaly sector, record 1 Route Note.

abilities.name: Ghost Mile
abilities.text: When you fail a movement or route test, you may spend 1 Route Note to reroll it.

abilities.name: Surveyor's Cut
abilities.text: Once per round, when you accept a route Contract, set its progress to at least 1.

abilities.name: Rift Script
abilities.text: After you pass a Signal or Guile test, another operative may use one Route Note from your sector this round. Weakness: Route Notes cannot be spent on battle rolls.
